kurals.drew: There is no one in the world so hard-hearted as those who can live without receiving (even) a kind word from their beloved

kurals.translit: Nasaiiyaar Nalkaar Eninum Avarmaattu / Isaiyum Iniya Sevikku
kurals.pope: Though he my heart desires no grace accords to me, Yet every accent of his voice is melody
kurals.drew: Though my beloved bestows no love on one, still are his words sweet to my ears

kurals.translit: Uraaarkku Urunoi Uraippaai Katalaich / Cheraaaai Vaazhiya Nenju
kurals.pope: Tell him thy pain that loves not thee?Farewell, my soul, fill up the sea
kurals.drew: Live, O my soul, would you who relate your great sorrow to strangers, try rather to fill up your own sea (of sorrow)

kurals.translit: Ullinum Theeraap Perumakizh Seydhalaal / Kallinum Kaamam Inidhu
kurals.pope: From thought of her unfailing gladness springs, Sweeter than palm-rice wine the joy love brings
kurals.drew: Sexuality is sweeter than liquor, because when remembered, it creates a most rapturous delight

kurals.translit: Enaiththonaru Inidhekaan Kaamamdhaam Veezhvaar / Ninaippa Varuvadhondru El
kurals.pope: How great is love! Behold its sweetness past belief!Think on the lover, and the spirit knows no grief
kurals.drew: Even to think of one's beloved gives one no pain Sexuality, in any degree, is always delightful

kurals.translit: Ninaippavar Pondru Ninaiyaarkol Thummal / Sinaippadhu Pondru Ketum
kurals.pope: A fit of sneezing threatened, but it passed away; He seemed to think of me, but do his fancies stray
kurals.drew: I feel as if I am going to sneeze but do not, and (therefore) my beloved is about to think (of me) but does not

kurals.translit: Yaamum Ulengol Avarnenjaththu Ennenjaththu / Oo Ulare Avar
kurals.pope: Have I a place within his heart!From mine, alas! he never doth depart
kurals.drew: He continues to abide in my soul, do I likewise abide in his ?

kurals.translit: Thamnenjaththu Emmaik Katikontaar Naanaarkol / Emnenjaththu Ovaa Varal
kurals.pope: Me from his heart he jealously excludes:Hath he no shame who ceaseless on my heart intrudes
kurals.drew: He who has imprisoned me in his soul, is he ashamed to enter incessantly into mine

kurals.translit: Matriyaan Ennulen Manno Avaroti / Yaan Utranaal Ulla Ulen
kurals.pope: How live I yet? I live to ponder o'erThe days of bliss with him that are no more
kurals.drew: I live by remembering my (former) intercourse with him; if it were not so, how could I live ?

kurals.translit: Marappin Evanaavan Markol Marappariyen / Ullinum Ullam Sutum
kurals.pope: If I remembered not what were I then? And yet, The fiery smart of what my spirit knows not to forget
kurals.drew: I have never forgotten (the pleasure); even to think of it burns my soul; could I live, if I should ever forget it ?

kurals.translit: Enaiththu Ninaippinum Kaayaar Anaiththandro / Kaadhalar Seyyum Sirappu
kurals.pope: My frequent thought no wrath excites It is not so?This honour doth my love on me bestow
kurals.drew: He will not be angry however much I may think of him; is it not so much the delight my beloved

kurals.translit: Viliyumen Innuyir Verallam Enpaar / Aliyinmai Aatra Ninaindhu
kurals.pope: Dear life departs, when his ungracious deeds I ponder o'er, Who said erewhile, 'We're one for evermore'
kurals.drew: My precious life is wasting away by thinking too much on the cruelty of him who said we were not different

kurals.translit: Vitaaadhu Sendraaraik Kanninaal Kaanap / Pataaadhi Vaazhi Madhi
kurals.pope: Set not; so may'st thou prosper, moon! that eyes may seeMy love who went away, but ever bides with me
kurals.drew: May you live, O Moon! Do not set, that I mine see him who has departed without quitting my soul

kurals.translit: Kaadhalar Thoodhotu Vandha Kanavinukku / Yaadhusey Venkol Virundhu
kurals.pope: It came and brought to me, that nightly vision rare, A message from my love,- what feast shall I prepare
kurals.drew: Where with shall I feast the dream which has brought me my dear one's messenger ?

kurals.translit: Kayalunkan Yaanirappath Thunjir Kalandhaarkku / Uyalunmai Saatruven Man
kurals.pope: If my dark, carp-like eye will close in sleep, as I implore, The tale of my long-suffering life I'll tell my loved one o'er
kurals.drew: If my fish-like painted eyes should, at my begging, close in sleep, I could fully relate my sufferings to my lord

kurals.translit: Nanavinaal Nalkaa Thavaraik Kanavinaal / Kaantalin Unten Uyir
kurals.pope: Him, who in waking hour no kindness shows, In dreams I see; and so my lifetime goes
kurals.drew: My life lasts because in my dream I behold him who does not favour me in my waking hours

kurals.translit: Kanavinaan Untaakum Kaamam Nanavinaan / Nalkaarai Naatith Thararku
kurals.pope: Some pleasure I enjoy when him who loves not meIn waking hours, the vision searches out and makes me see
kurals.drew: There is pleasure in my dream, because in it I seek and obtain him who does not visit me in my wakefulness

kurals.translit: Nanavinaal Kantadhooum Aange Kanavundhaan / Kanta Pozhudhe Inidhu
kurals.pope: As what I then beheld in waking hour was sweet, So pleasant dreams in hour of sleep my spirit greet
kurals.drew: I saw him in my waking hours, and then it was pleasant; I see him just now in my dream, and it is (equally) pleasant

kurals.translit: Nanavena Ondrillai Aayin Kanavinaal / Kaadhalar Neengalar Man
kurals.pope: And if there were no waking hour, my loveIn dreams would never from my side remove
kurals.drew: Were there no such thing as wakefulness, my beloved (who visited me) in my dream would not depart from me

kurals.translit: Nanavinaal Nalkaak Kotiyaar Kanavanaal / Enemmaip Peezhip Padhu
kurals.pope: The cruel one, in waking hour, who all ungracious seems, Why should he thus torment my soul in nightly dreams
kurals.drew: The cruel one who would not favour me in my wakefulness, what right has he to torture me in my dreams?

kurals.translit: Thunjungaal Tholmelar Aaki Vizhikkungaal / Nenjaththar Aavar Viraindhu
kurals.pope: And when I sleep he holds my form embraced; And when I wake to fill my heart makes haste
kurals.drew: When I am asleep he rests on my shoulders, (but) when I awake he hastens into my soul

kurals.translit: Nanavinaal Nalkaarai Novar Kanavinaal / Kaadhalark Kaanaa Thavar
kurals.pope: In dreams who ne'er their lover's form perceive, For those in waking hours who show no love will grieve
kurals.drew: They who have no dear ones to behold in their dreams blame him who visits me not in my waking hours

kurals.translit: Nanavinaal Namneeththaar Enpar Kanavinaal / Kaanaarkol Ivvoo Ravar
kurals.pope: They say, that he in waking hours has left me lone; In dreams they surely see him not,- these people of the town;
kurals.drew: The women of this place say he has forsaken me in my wakefulness I think they have not seen him visit me in my dreams

kurals.translit: Maalaiyo Allai Manandhaar Uyirunnum / Velainee Vaazhi Pozhudhu
kurals.pope: Thou art not evening, but a spear that doth devourThe souls of brides; farewell, thou evening hour
kurals.drew: Live, O you evening are you (the former) evening? No, you are the season that slays (married) women

kurals.translit: Punkannai Vaazhi Marulmaalai Emkelpol / Vankanna Thonin Thunai
kurals.pope: Thine eye is sad; Hail, doubtful hour of eventide!Of cruel eye, as is my spouse, is too thy bride
kurals.drew: A long life to you, O dark evening! You are sightless Is your help-mate (also) as hard-hearted as mine

kurals.translit: Paniarumpip Paidhalkol Maalai Thuniarumpith / Thunpam Valara Varum
kurals.pope: With buds of chilly dew wan evening's shade enclose; My anguish buds space and all my sorrow grows
kurals.drew: The evening that (once) came in with trembling and dimness (now) brings me an aversion for life and increasing sorrow

kurals.translit: Kaadhalar Ilvazhi Maalai Kolaikkalaththu / Edhilar Pola Varum
kurals.pope: When absent is my love, the evening hour descends, As when an alien host to field of battle wends
kurals.drew: In the absence of my lover, evening comes in like slayers on the field of slaughter

kurals.translit: Kaalaikkuch Cheydhanandru Enkol Evankolyaan / Maalaikkuch Cheydha Pakai?
kurals.pope: O morn, how have I won thy grace? thou bring'st reliefO eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief
kurals.drew: O eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief

kurals.translit: Maalainoi Seydhal Manandhaar Akalaadha / Kaalai Arindha Thilen
kurals.pope: The pangs that evening brings I never knew, Till he, my wedded spouse, from me withdrew
kurals.drew: Previous to my husband's departure, I know not the painful nature of evening

kurals.translit: Kaalai Arumpip Pakalellaam Podhaaki / Maalai Malarumin Noi
kurals.pope: My grief at morn a bud, all day an opening flower, Full-blown expands in evening hour
kurals.drew: This malady buds forth in the morning, expands all day long and blossoms in the evening

kurals.translit: Azhalpolum Maalaikkuth Thoodhaaki Aayan / Kuzhalpolum Kollum Patai
kurals.pope: The shepherd's pipe is like a murderous weapon, to my ear, For it proclaims the hour of ev'ning's fiery anguish near
kurals.drew: The shepherd's flute now sounds as a fiery forerunner of night, and is become a weapon that slays (me)

kurals.translit: Padhimaruntu Paidhal Uzhakkum Madhimaruntu / Maalai Patardharum Pozhdhu
kurals.pope: If evening's shades, that darken all my soul, extend; From this afflicted town will would of grief ascend
kurals.drew: When night comes on confusing (everyone's) mind, the (whole) town will lose its sense and be plunged in sorrow

kurals.translit: Porulmaalai Yaalarai Ulli Marulmaalai / Maayumen Maayaa Uyir
kurals.pope: This darkening eve, my darkling soul must perish utterly; Remembering him who seeks for wealth, but seeks not me
kurals.drew: My (hitherto) unextinguished life is now lost in this bewildering night at the thought of him who has the nature of wealth

kurals.translit: Sirumai Namakkozhiyach Chetchendraar Ulli / Narumalar Naanina Kan
kurals.pope: Thine eyes grown dim are now ashamed the fragrant flow'rs to see, Thinking on him, who wand'ring far, leaves us in misery
kurals.drew: While we endure the unbearable sorrow, your eyes weep for him who is gone afar, and shun (the sight of) fragrant flowers

kurals.translit: Nayandhavar Nalkaamai Solluva Polum / Pasandhu Panivaarum Kan
kurals.pope: The eye, with sorrow wan, all wet with dew of tears, As witness of the lover's lack of love appears
kurals.drew: The discoloured eyes that shed tears profusely seem to betray the unkindness of our beloved

kurals.translit: Thanandhamai Saala Arivippa Polum / Manandhanaal Veengiya Thol
kurals.pope: These withered arms, desertion's pangs abundantly display, That swelled with joy on that glad nuptial day
kurals.drew: The shoulders that swelled on the day of our union (now) seem to announce our separation clearly (to the public)

kurals.translit: Panaineengip Paindhoti Sorum Thunaineengith / Tholkavin Vaatiya Thol
kurals.pope: When lover went, then faded all their wonted charms, And armlets' golden round slips off from these poor wasted arms
kurals.drew: In the absence of your consort, your shoulders having lost their former beauty and fulness, your bracelets of pure gold have become loose

kurals.translit: Kotiyaar Kotumai Uraikkum Thotiyotu / Tholkavin Vaatiya Thol
kurals.pope: These wasted arms, the bracelet with their wonted beauty gone, The cruelty declare of that most cruel one
kurals.drew: The (loosened) bracelets, and the shoulders from which the old beauty has faded, relate the cruelty of the pitiless one

kurals.translit: Thotiyotu Tholnekizha Noval Avaraik / Kotiyar Enakkooral Nondhu
kurals.pope: I grieve, 'tis pain to me to hear him cruel chid, Because the armlet from my wasted arm has slid
kurals.drew: I am greatly pained to hear you call him a cruel man, just because your shoulders are reduced and your bracelets loosened

kurals.translit: Paatu Perudhiyo Nenje Kotiyaarkken / Vaatudhot Poosal Uraiththu
kurals.pope: My heart! say ought of glory wilt thou gain, If to that cruel one thou of thy wasted arms complain
kurals.drew: Can you O my soul! gain glory by relating to the (so-called) cruel one the clamour of my fading shoulders?

kurals.translit: Muyangiya Kaikalai Ookkap Pasandhadhu / Paindhotip Pedhai Nudhal
kurals.pope: One day the fervent pressure of embracing arms I checked, Grew wan the forehead of the maid with golden armlet decked
kurals.drew: When I once loosened the arms that were in embrace, the forehead of the gold-braceleted women turned sallow

kurals.translit: Muyakkitaith Thanvali Pozhap Pasapputra / Pedhai Perumazhaik Kan
kurals.pope: As we embraced a breath of wind found entrance there; The maid's large liquid eyes were dimmed with care
kurals.drew: When but a breath of breeze penetrated our embrace, her large cool eyes became sallow

kurals.translit: Kannin Pasappo Paruvaral Eydhindre / Onnudhal Seydhadhu Kantu
kurals.pope: The dimness of her eye felt sorrow now, Beholding what was done by that bright brow
kurals.drew: Was it at the sight of what the bright forehead had done that the sallowness of her eyes became sad?

kurals.translit: Ninaiththondru Sollaayo Nenje Enaiththondrum / Evvanoi Theerkkum Marundhu
kurals.pope: My heart, canst thou not thinking of some med'cine tell, Not any one, to drive away this grief incurable
kurals.drew: O my soul, will you not think and tell me some medicine be it what it may, that can cure this incurable malady?

kurals.translit: Kaadhal Avarilar Aakanee Novadhu / Pedhaimai Vaazhiyen Nenju
kurals.pope: Since he loves not, thy smartIs folly, fare thee well my heart
kurals.drew: Is folly, fare thee well my heart!

kurals.translit: Irundhulli Enparidhal Nenje Parindhullal / Paidhalnoi Seydhaarkan Il
kurals.pope: What comes of sitting here in pining thought, O heart? He knowsNo pitying thought, the cause of all these wasting woes
kurals.drew: O my soul! why remain (here) and suffer thinking (of him)? There are no lewd thoughts (of you) in him who has caused you this disease of sorrow

kurals.translit: Kannum Kolachcheri Nenje Ivaiyennaith / Thinnum Avarkkaanal Utru
kurals.pope: O rid me of these eyes, my heart; for they, Longing to see him, wear my life away
kurals.drew: O my soul! take my eyes also with you, (if not), these would eat me up (in their desire) to see him

kurals.translit: Setraar Enakkai Vitalunto Nenjeyaam / Utraal Uraaa Thavar
kurals.pope: O heart, as a foe, can I abandon utterlyHim who, though I long for him, longs not for me
kurals.drew: O my soul! can he who loves not though he is beloved, be forsaken saying he hates me (now)?

kurals.translit: Kalandhunarththum Kaadhalark Kantaar Pulandhunaraai / Poikkaaivu Kaaidhien Nenju
kurals.pope: My heart, false is the fire that burns; thou canst not wrath maintain, If thou thy love behold, embracing, soothing all thy pain
kurals.drew: O my soul! when you see the dear one who remove dislike by intercourse, you are displeased and continue to be so Nay, your displeasure is (simply) false

kurals.translit: Kaamam Vituondro Naanvitu Nannenje / Yaano Poreniv Virantu
kurals.pope: Or bid thy love, or bid thy shame depart; For me, I cannot bear them both, my worthy heart
kurals.drew: O my good soul, give up either lust or honour, as for me I can endure neither

kurals.translit: Parindhavar Nalkaarendru Engip Pirindhavar / Pinselvaai Pedhaien Nenju
kurals.pope: Thou art befooled, my heart, thou followest him who flees from thee; And still thou yearning criest: 'He will nor pity show nor love to me.'
kurals.drew: You are a fool, O my soul! to go after my departed one, while you mourn that he is not kind enough to favour you

kurals.translit: Ullaththaar Kaadha Lavaraal Ullinee / Yaaruzhaich Cheriyen Nenju
kurals.pope: My heart! my lover lives within my mind; Roaming, whom dost thou think to find
kurals.drew: O my soul! to whom would you repair, while the dear one is within yourself?

kurals.translit: Thunnaath Thurandhaarai Nenjaththu Utaiyemaa / Innum Izhaththum Kavin
kurals.pope: If I should keep in mind the man who utterly renounces me, My soul must suffer further loss of dignity
kurals.drew: If I retain in my heart him who has left me without befriending me, I shall lose even the (inward) beauty that remains

kurals.translit: Kaamak Kanichchi Utaikkum Niraiyennum / Naanuththaazh Veezhththa Kadhavu
kurals.pope: Of womanly reserve love's axe breaks through the door, Barred by the bolt of shame before
kurals.drew: The axe of lust can break the door of chastity which is bolted with the bolt of modesty

kurals.translit: Kaamam Enavondro Kannindren Nenjaththai / Yaamaththum Aalum Thozhil
kurals.pope: What men call love is the one thing of merciless power; It gives my soul no rest, e'en in the midnight hour
kurals.drew: Even at midnight is my mind worried by lust, and this one thing, alas! is without mercy

kurals.translit: Maraippenman Kaamaththai Yaano Kurippindrith / Thummalpol Thondri Vitum
kurals.pope: I would my love conceal, but like a sneezeIt shows itself, and gives no warning sign
kurals.drew: I would conceal my lust, but alas, it yields not to my will but breaks out like a sneeze

kurals.translit: Niraiyutaiyen Enpenman Yaanoen Kaamam / Maraiyirandhu Mandru Patum
kurals.pope: In womanly reserve I deemed myself beyond assail; But love will come abroad, and casts away the veil
kurals.drew: I say I would be firm, but alas, my malady breaks out from its concealment and appears in public

kurals.translit: Setraarpin Sellaap Perundhakaimai Kaamanoi / Utraar Arivadhondru Andru
kurals.pope: The dignity that seeks not him who acts as foe, Is the one thing that loving heart can never know
kurals.drew: The dignity that would not go after an absent lover is not known to those who are sticken by love

kurals.translit: Setravar Pinseral Venti Aliththaro / Etrennai Utra Thuyar
kurals.pope: My grief how full of grace, I pray you see!It seeks to follow him that hateth me
kurals.drew: The sorrow I have endured by desiring to go after my absent lover, in what way is it excellent?

kurals.translit: Naanena Ondro Ariyalam Kaamaththaal / Peniyaar Petpa Seyin
kurals.pope: No sense of shame my gladdened mind shall prove, When he returns my longing heart to bless with love
kurals.drew: I know nothing like shame when my beloved does from love (just) what is desired (by me)

kurals.translit: Panmaayak Kalvan Panimozhi Andronam / Penmai Utaikkum Patai
kurals.pope: The words of that deceiver, versed in every wily art, Are instruments that break through every guard of woman's heart
kurals.drew: Are not the enticing words of my trick-abounding roguish lover the weapon that breaks away my feminine firmness?

kurals.translit: Pulappal Enachchendren Pullinen Nenjam / Kalaththal Uruvadhu Kantu
kurals.pope: 'I 'll shun his greeting'; saying thus with pride away I went:I held him in my arms, for straight I felt my heart relent
kurals.drew: I said I would feign dislike and so went (away); (but) I embraced him the moment I say my mind began to unite with him!

kurals.translit: Ninandheeyil Ittanna Nenjinaarkku Unto / Punarndhooti Nirpem Enal
kurals.pope: 'We 'll stand aloof and then embrace': is this for them to say, Whose hearts are as the fat that in the blaze dissolves away
kurals.drew: Is it possible for those whose hearts melt like fat in the fire to say they can feign a strong dislike and remain so?

kurals.translit: Vaalatrup Purkendra Kannum Avarsendra / Naalotrith Theyndha Viral
kurals.pope: My eyes have lost their brightness, sight is dimmed; my fingers worn, With nothing on the wall the days since I was left forlorn
kurals.drew: My finger has worn away by marking (on the wall) the days he has been absent while my eyes have lost their lustre and begin to fail

kurals.translit: Ilangizhaai Indru Marappinen Tholmel / Kalangazhiyum Kaarikai Neeththu
kurals.pope: O thou with gleaming jewels decked, could I forget for this one day, Henceforth these bracelets from my arms will slip, my beauty worn away
kurals.drew: O you bright-jewelled maid, if I forget (him) today, my shoulders will lose their beauty even in the other life and make my bracelets loose

kurals.translit: Urannasaii Ullam Thunaiyaakach Chendraar / Varalnasaii Innum Ulen
kurals.pope: On victory intent, His mind sole company he went; And I yet life sustain And long to see his face again
kurals.drew: I still live by longing for the arrival of him who has gone out of love for victory and with valour as his guide

kurals.translit: Kootiya Kaamam Pirindhaar Varavullik / Kotuko Terumen Nenju
kurals.pope: 'He comes again, who left my side, and I shall taste love's joy,'-My heart with rapture swells, when thoughts like these my mind employ
kurals.drew: My heart is rid of its sorrow and swells with rapture to think of my absent lover returning with his love

kurals.translit: Kaankaman Konkanaik Kannaarak Kantapin / Neengumen Mendhol Pasappu
kurals.pope: O let me see my spouse again and sate these longing eyes!That instant from my wasted frame all pallor flies
kurals.drew: May I look on my lover till I am satisfied and thereafter will vanish the sallowness of my slender shoulders

kurals.translit: Varukaman Konkan Orunaal Parukuvan / Paidhalnoi Ellaam Keta
kurals.pope: O let my spouse but come again to me one day!I'll drink that nectar: wasting grief shall flee away
kurals.drew: May my husband return some day; and then will I enjoy (him) so as to destroy all this agonizing sorrow

kurals.translit: Pulappenkol Pulluven Kollo Kalappenkol / Kananna Kelir Viran
kurals.pope: Shall I draw back, or yield myself, or shall both mingled be, When he returns, my spouse, dear as these eyes to me
kurals.drew: On the return of him who is as dear as my eyes, am I displeased or am I to embrace (him); or am I to do both?

kurals.translit: Vinaikalandhu Vendreeka Vendhan Manaikalandhu / Maalai Ayarkam Virundhu
kurals.pope: O would my king would fight, o'ercome, devide the spoil; At home, to-night, the banquet spread should crown the toil
kurals.drew: Let the king fight and gain (victories); (but) let me be united to my wife and feast the evening

kurals.translit: Orunaal Ezhunaalpol Sellumsen Sendraar / Varunaalvaiththu Engu Pavarkku
kurals.pope: One day will seem like seven to those who watch and yearnFor that glad day when wanderers from afar return
kurals.drew: To those who suffer waiting for the day of return of their distant lovers one day is as long as seven days

kurals.translit: Perinennaam Petrakkaal Ennaam Urinennaam / Ullam Utaindhukkak Kaal
kurals.pope: What's my return, the meeting hour, the wished-for greeting worth, If she heart-broken lie, with all her life poured forth
kurals.drew: After (my wife) has died of a broken heart, what good will there be if she is to receive me, has received me, or has even embraced me?

kurals.translit: Karappinung Kaiyikan Thollaanin Unkan / Uraikkal Uruvadhon Runtu
kurals.pope: Thou hid'st it, yet thine eye, disdaining all restraint, Something, I know not, what, would utter of complaint
kurals.drew: Though you would conceal (your feelings), your painted eyes would not, for, transgressing (their bounds), they tell (me) something

kurals.translit: Kanniraindha Kaarikaik Kaamperdhot Pedhaikkup / Penniraindha Neermai Peridhu
kurals.pope: The simple one whose beauty fills mine eye, whose shoulders curveLike bambu stem, hath all a woman's modest sweet reserve
kurals.drew: Unusually great is the female simplicity of your maid whose beauty fills my eyes and whose shoulders resemble the bamboo

kurals.translit: Maniyil Thikazhdharu Noolpol Matandhai / Aniyil Thikazhvadhondru Untu
kurals.pope: As through the crystal beads is seen the thread on which they 're strungSo in her beauty gleams some thought cannot find a tongue
kurals.drew: There is something that is implied in the beauty of this woman, like the thread that is visible in a garland of gems

kurals.translit: Mukaimokkul Ulladhu Naatrampol Pedhai / Nakaimokkul Ulladhon Runtu
kurals.pope: As fragrance in the opening bud, some secret liesConcealed in budding smile of this dear damsel's eyes
kurals.drew: There is something in the unmatured smile of this maid like the fragrance that is contained in an unblossomed bud

kurals.translit: Seridhoti Seydhirandha Kallam Urudhuyar / Theerkkum Marundhondru Utaiththu
kurals.pope: The secret wiles of her with thronging armlets decked, Are medicines by which my raising grief is checked
kurals.drew: The well-meant departure of her whose bangles are tight-fitting contains a remedy that can cure my great sorrow

kurals.translit: Peridhaatrip Petpak Kalaththal Aridhaatri / Anpinmai Soozhva Thutaiththu
kurals.pope: While lovingly embracing me, his heart is only grieved:It makes me think that I again shall live of love bereaved
kurals.drew: The embrace that fills me with comfort and gladness is capable of enduring (my former) sorrow and meditating on his want of love

kurals.translit: Thannan Thuraivan Thanandhamai Namminum / Munnam Unarndha Valai
kurals.pope: My severance from the lord of this cool shore, My very armlets told me long before
kurals.drew: My bracelets have understood before me the (mental) separation of him who rules the cool seashore

kurals.translit: Nerunatruch Chendraarem Kaadhalar Yaamum / Ezhunaalem Meni Pasandhu
kurals.pope: My loved one left me, was it yesterday?Days seven my pallid body wastes away
kurals.drew: It was but yesterday my lover departed (from me); and it is seven days since my complexion turned sallow

kurals.translit: Thotinokki Mendholum Nokki Atinokki / Aqdhaan Tavalsey Thadhu
kurals.pope: She viewed her tender arms, she viewed the armlets from them slid; She viewed her feet: all this the lady did
kurals.drew: She looked at her bracelets, her tender shoulders, and her feet; this was what she did there (significantly)

kurals.translit: Penninaal Penmai Utaiththenpa Kanninaal / Kaamanoi Solli Iravu
kurals.pope: To show by eye the pain of love, and for relief to pray, Is womanhood's most womanly device, men say
kurals.drew: To express their love-sickness by their eyes and resort to begging bespeaks more than ordinary female excellence

kurals.translit: Ullak Kaliththalum Kaana Makizhdhalum / Kallukkil Kaamaththir Kuntu
kurals.pope: Gladness at the thought, rejoicing at the sight, Not palm-tree wine, but love, yields such delight
kurals.drew: To please by thought and cheer by sight is peculiar, not to liquor but lust

kurals.translit: Thinaiththunaiyum Ootaamai Ventum Panaith / Thunaiyum Kaamam Niraiya Varin
kurals.pope: When as palmyra tall, fulness of perfect love we gain, Distrust can find no place small as the millet grain
kurals.drew: If women have a lust that exceeds even the measure of the palmyra fruit, they will not desire (to feign) dislike even as much as the millet

kurals.translit: Penaadhu Petpave Seyyinum Konkanaik / Kaanaa Thamaiyala Kan
kurals.pope: Although his will his only law, he lightly value me, My heart knows no repose unless my lord I see
kurals.drew: Though my eyes disregard me and do what is pleasing to my husband, still will they not be satisfied unless they see him

kurals.translit: Ootarkan Sendrenman Thozhi Adhumarandhu / Kootarkan Sendradhu En Nenju
kurals.pope: My friend, I went prepared to show a cool disdain; My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain
kurals.drew: My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain

kurals.translit: Ezhudhungaal Kolkaanaak Kannepol Konkan / Pazhikaanen Kanta Itaththu
kurals.pope: The eye sees not the rod that paints it; nor can ISee any fault, when I behold my husband nigh
kurals.drew: Like the eyes which see not the pencil that paints it, I cannot see my husband's fault (just) when I meet him

kurals.translit: Kaanungaal Kaanen Thavaraaya Kaanaakkaal / Kaanen Thavaral Lavai
kurals.pope: When him I see, to all his faults I 'm blind; But when I see him not, nothing but faults I find
kurals.drew: When I see my husband, I do not see any faults; but when I do not see him, I do not see anything but faults

kurals.translit: Uyththal Arindhu Punalpaai Pavarepol / Poiththal Arindhen Pulandhu
kurals.pope: As those of rescue sure, who plunge into the stream, So did I anger feign, though it must falsehood seem
kurals.drew: Like those who leap into a stream which they know will carry them off, why should a wife feign dislike which she knows cannot hold out long?

kurals.translit: Iliththakka Innaa Seyinum Kaliththaarkkuk / Kallatre Kalvanin Maarpu
kurals.pope: Though shameful ill it works, dear is the palm-tree wineTo drunkards; traitor, so to me that breast of thine
kurals.drew: O you rogue! your breast is to me what liquor is to those who rejoice in it, though it only gives them an unpleasant disgrace

kurals.translit: Malarinum Mellidhu Kaamam Silaradhan / Sevvi Thalaippatu Vaar
kurals.pope: Love is tender as an opening flower In season dueTo gain its perfect bliss is rapture known to few
kurals.drew: Sexual delight is more delicate than a flower, and few are those who understand its real nature

kurals.translit: Kannin Thuniththe Kalanginaal Pulludhal / Enninum Thaanvidhup Putru
kurals.pope: Her eye, as I drew nigh one day, with anger shone:By love o'erpowered, her tenderness surpassed my own
kurals.drew: She once feigned dislike in her eyes, but the warmth of her embrace exceeded my own

kurals.translit: Avarnenju Avarkkaadhal Kantum Evannenje / Neeemakku Aakaa Thadhu
kurals.pope: You see his heart is his aloneO heart, why not be all my own
kurals.drew: O my soul! although you have seen how his soul stands by him, how is it you do not stand by me?

kurals.translit: Uraaa Thavarkkanta Kannum Avaraich / Cheraaarenach Cheriyen Nenju
kurals.pope: 'Tis plain, my heart, that he 's estranged from thee; Why go to him as though he were not enemy
kurals.drew: O my soul! although you have known him who does not love me, still do you go to him, saying "he will not be displeased."

kurals.translit: Kettaarkku Nattaaril Enpadho Nenjenee / Pettaangu Avarpin Selal
kurals.pope: 'The ruined have no friends, 'they say; and so, my heart, To follow him, at thy desire, from me thou dost depart
kurals.drew: O my soul! do you follow him at pleasure under the belief that the ruined have no friends?

kurals.translit: Inianna Ninnotu Soozhvaaryaar Nenje / Thuniseydhu Thuvvaaikaan Matru
kurals.pope: 'See, thou first show offended pride, and then submit,' I bade; Henceforth such council who will share with thee my heart
kurals.drew: O my soul! you would not first seem sulky and then enjoy (him); who then would in future consult you about such things?

kurals.translit: Peraaamai Anjum Perinpirivu Anjum / Araaa Itumpaiththen Nenju
kurals.pope: I fear I shall not gain, I fear to lose him when I gain; And thus my heart endures unceasing pain
kurals.drew: My soul fears when it is without him; it also fears when it is with him; it is subject to incessant sorrow

kurals.translit: Thaniye Irundhu Ninaiththakkaal Ennaith / Thiniya Irundhadhen Nenju
kurals.pope: My heart consumes me when I ponder lone, And all my lover's cruelty bemoan
kurals.drew: My mind has been (here) in order to eat me up (as it were) whenever I think of him in my solitude

kurals.translit: Naanum Marandhen Avarmarak Kallaaen / Maanaa Matanenjir Pattu
kurals.pope: Fall'n 'neath the sway of this ignoble foolish heart, Which will not him forget, I have forgotten shame
kurals.drew: I have even forgotten my modesty, having been caught in my foolish mind which is not dignified enough to forget him

kurals.translit: Ellin Ilivaamendru Enni Avardhiram / Ullum Uyirkkaadhal Nenju
kurals.pope: If I contemn him, then disgrace awaits me evermore; My soul that seeks to live his virtues numbers o'er
kurals.drew: My soul which clings to life thinks only of his (own) gain in the belief that it would be disgraceful for it to despise him

kurals.translit: Thunpaththirku Yaare Thunaiyaavaar Thaamutaiya / Nenjan Thunaiyal Vazhi
kurals.pope: And who will aid me in my hour of grief, If my own heart comes not to my relief
kurals.drew: Who would help me out of one's distress, when one's own soul refuses help to one?

kurals.translit: Thanjam Thamarallar Edhilaar Thaamutaiya / Nenjam Thamaral Vazhi
kurals.pope: A trifle is unfriendliness by aliens shown, When our own heart itself is not our own
kurals.drew: It is hardly possible for strangers to behave like relations, when one's own soul acts like a stranger

kurals.translit: Pullaa Thiraaap Pulaththai Avar / Urum Allalnoi Kaankam Siridhu
kurals.pope: Be still reserved, decline his profferred love; A little while his sore distress we 'll prove
kurals.drew: Let us witness awhile his keen suffering; just feign dislike and embrace him not

kurals.translit: Uppamain Thatraal Pulavi Adhusiridhu / Mikkatraal Neela Vital
kurals.pope: A cool reserve is like the salt that seasons well the mess, Too long maintained, 'tis like the salt's excess
kurals.drew: A little dislike is like salt in proportion; to prolong it a little is like salt a little too much

kurals.translit: Alandhaarai Allalnoi Seydhatraal Thammaip / Pulandhaaraip Pullaa Vital
kurals.pope: 'Tis heaping griefs on those whose hearts are grieved; To leave the grieving one without a fond embrace
kurals.drew: For men not to embrace those who have feigned dislike is like torturing those already in agony

kurals.translit: Ooti Yavarai Unaraamai Vaatiya / Valli Mudhalarin Thatru
kurals.pope: To use no kind conciliating art when lover grieves, Is cutting out the root of tender winding plant that droops
kurals.drew: Not to reconcile those who have feigned dislike is like cutting a faded creeper at its root

kurals.translit: Nalaththakai Nallavarkku Eer Pulaththakai / Pooanna Kannaar Akaththu
kurals.pope: Even to men of good and worthy mind, the petulanceOf wives with flowery eyes lacks not a lovely grace
kurals.drew: An increased shyness in those whose eyes are like flowers is beautiful even to good and virtuous husbands

kurals.translit: Thuniyum Pulaviyum Illaayin Kaamam / Kaniyum Karukkaayum Atru
kurals.pope: Love without hatred is ripened fruit; Without some lesser strife, fruit immature
kurals.drew: Sexual pleasure, without prolonged and short-lived dislike, is like too ripe, and unripe fruit

kurals.translit: Ootalin Untaangor Thunpam Punarvadhu / Neetuva Thandru Kol Endru
kurals.pope: A lovers' quarrel brings its pain, when mind afraidAsks doubtful, 'Will reunion sweet be long delayed?'
kurals.drew: The doubt as to whether intercourse would take place soon or not, creates a sorrow (even) in feigned dislike

kurals.translit: Nodhal Evanmatru Nondhaarendru Aqdhariyum / Kaadhalar Illaa Vazhi
kurals.pope: What good can grieving do, when none who loveAre there to know the grief thy soul endures
kurals.drew: What avails sorrow when I am without a wife who can understand the cause of my sorrow?

kurals.translit: Neerum Nizhaladhu Inidhe Pulaviyum / Veezhunar Kanne Inidhu
kurals.pope: Water is pleasant in the cooling shade; So coolness for a time with those we love
kurals.drew: Like water in the shade, dislike is delicious only in those who love

kurals.translit: Ootal Unanga Vituvaarotu Ennenjam / Kootuvem Enpadhu Avaa
kurals.pope: Of her who leaves me thus in variance languishing, To think within my heart with love is fond desire
kurals.drew: It is nothing but strong desire that makes her mind unite with me who can leave her to her own dislike

kurals.translit: Penniyalaar Ellaarum Kannin Podhuunpar / Nannen Paraththanin Maarpu
kurals.pope: From thy regard all womankind Enjoys an equal grace; O thou of wandering fickle mind, I shrink from thine embrace
kurals.drew: You are given to prostitution; all those who are born as womankind enjoy you with their eyes in an ordinary way I will not embrace you

kurals.translit: Ooti Irundhemaath Thumminaar Yaamdhammai / Neetuvaazh Kenpaak Karindhu
kurals.pope: One day we silent sulked; he sneezed: The reason well I knew; He thought that I, to speak well pleased, Would say, 'Long life to you!'
kurals.drew: When I continued to be sulky he sneezed and thought I would (then) wish him a long life

kurals.translit: Kottup Pooch Chootinum Kaayum / Oruththiyaik Kaattiya Sootineer Endru
kurals.pope: I wreathed with flowers one day my brow, The angry tempest lowers; She cries, 'Pray, for what woman now Do you put on your flowers?'
kurals.drew: Even if I were adorned with a garland of branch-flowers, she would say I did so to show it to another woman

kurals.translit: Yaarinum Kaadhalam Endrenaa Ootinaal / Yaarinum Yaarinum Endru
kurals.pope: 'I love you more than all beside,' 'T was thus I gently spoke;'What all, what all?' she instant cried; And all her anger woke
kurals.drew: When I said I loved her more than any other woman, she said "more than others, yes, more than others," and remained sulky

kurals.translit: Immaip Pirappil Piriyalam Endrenaak / Kannirai Neerkon Tanal
kurals.pope: 'While here I live, I leave you not,' I said to calm her fearsShe cried, 'There, then, I read your thought'; And straight dissolved in tears
kurals.drew: When I said I would never part from her in this life her eyes were filled with tears

kurals.translit: Ullinen Endrenmar Renmarandheer Endrennaip / Pullaal Pulaththak Kanal
kurals.pope: 'Each day I called to mind your charms,' 'O, then, you had forgot,'She cried, and then her opened arms, Forthwith embraced me not
kurals.drew: When I said I had remembered her, she said I had forgotten her and relaxing her embrace, began to feign dislike

kurals.translit: Vazhuththinaal Thumminen Aaka Azhiththazhudhaal / Yaarullith Thummineer Endru
kurals.pope: She hailed me when I sneezed one day; But straight with anger seized, She cried; 'Who was the woman, pray, Thinking of whom you sneezed?'
kurals.drew: When I sneezed she blessed me, but at once changed (her mind) and wept, asking, "At the thought of whom did you sneeze?"

kurals.translit: Thummuch Cheruppa Azhudhaal Numarullal / Emmai Maraiththiro Endru
kurals.pope: And so next time I checked my sneeze; She forthwith wept and cried,(That woman difficult to please), 'Your thoughts from me you hide'
kurals.drew: When I suppressed my sneezing, she wept saying, "I suppose you (did so) to hide from me your own people's remembrance of you"

kurals.translit: Thannai Unarththinum Kaayum Pirarkkumneer / Inneerar Aakudhir Endru
kurals.pope: I then began to soothe and coax, To calm her jealous mind;'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind
kurals.drew: 'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind' Even when I try to remove her dislike, she is displeased and says, "This is the way you behave

kurals.translit: Ninaiththirundhu Nokkinum Kaayum Anaiththuneer / Yaarulli Nokkineer Endru
kurals.pope: I silent sat, but thought the more, And gazed on her Then sheCried out, 'While thus you eye me o'er, Tell me whose form you see'
kurals.drew: Even when I look on her contemplating (her beauty), she is displeased and says, "With whose thought have you (thus) looked on my person?"

kurals.translit: Illai Thavaravarkku Aayinum Ootudhal / Valladhu Avaralikku Maaru
kurals.pope: Although there be no fault in him, the sweetness of his loveHath power in me a fretful jealousy to move
kurals.drew: Although my husband is free from defects, the way in which he embraces me is such as to make me feign dislike

kurals.translit: Ootalin Thondrum Sirudhuni Nallali / Vaatinum Paatu Perum
kurals.pope: My 'anger feigned' gives but a little pain; And when affection droops, it makes it bloom again
kurals.drew: His love will increase though it may (at first seem to) fade through the short-lived distress caused by (my) dislike

kurals.translit: Pulaththalin Puththelnaatu Unto Nilaththotu / Neeriyain Thannaar Akaththu
kurals.pope: Is there a bliss in any world more utterly divine, Than 'coyness' gives, when hearts as earth and water join
kurals.drew: Is there a celestial land that can please like the feigned dislike of those whose union resembles that of earth and water?

kurals.translit: Pulli Vitaaap Pulaviyul Thondrumen / Ullam Utaikkum Patai
kurals.pope: 'Within the anger feigned' that close love's tie doth bind, A weapon lurks, which quite breaks down my mind
kurals.drew: In prolonged dislike after an embrace there is a weapon that can break my heart

kurals.translit: Thavarilar Aayinum Thaamveezhvaar Mendrol / Akaralin Aangon Rutaiththu
kurals.pope: Though free from fault, from loved one's tender armsTo be estranged a while hath its own special charms
kurals.drew: Though free from defects, men feel pleased when they cannot embrace the delicate shoulders of those whom they love

kurals.translit: Unalinum Untadhu Aralinidhu Kaamam / Punardhalin Ootal Inidhu
kurals.pope: 'Tis sweeter to digest your food than 'tis to eat; In love, than union's self is anger feigned more sweet
kurals.drew: To digest what has been eaten is more delightful than to eat more; likewise love is more delightful in dislike than intercourse

kurals.translit: Ootalil Thotravar Vendraar Adhumannum / Kootalir Kaanap Patum
kurals.pope: In lovers' quarrels, 'tis the one that first gives way, That in re-union's joy is seen to win the day
kurals.drew: Those are conquerors whose dislike has been defeated and that is proved by the love (which

kurals.translit: Ootip Perukuvam Kollo Nudhalveyarppak / Kootalil Thondriya Uppu
kurals.pope: And shall we ever more the sweetness know of that embraceWith dewy brow; to which 'feigned anger' lent its piquant grace
kurals.drew: Will I enjoy once more through her dislike, the pleasure of that love that makes her forehead perspire?

kurals.translit: Ootuka Manno Oliyizhai Yaamirappa / Neetuka Manno Iraa
kurals.pope: Let her, whose jewels brightly shine, aversion feignThat I may still plead on, O night, prolong thy reign
kurals.drew: May the bright-jewelled one feign dislike, and may the night be prolonged for me to implore her!

kurals.translit: Ootudhal Kaamaththirku Inpam Adharkinpam / Kooti Muyangap Perin
kurals.pope: A 'feigned aversion' coy to pleasure gives a zest; The pleasure's crowned when breast is clasped to breast
kurals.drew: Dislike adds delight to love; and a hearty embrace (thereafter) will add delight to dislike
